entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are adept at instigating wars among those you advise or antagonize.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, hobgoblin.

Benefit(s): You gain Bluff and Diplomacy as class skills. In addition, you receive a +4 competence bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy skill checks when using either skill to convince another character to go to war against or attack another creature or group.
